_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats under 69 banners around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its segments compete with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarkets, and 'internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2013 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats under 69 banners around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its segments compete with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarkets, and 'internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2013 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.42x; +14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.90; conservative 2yr +15%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.7%/yr (Q4 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.3%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2013-05-10) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.42x (17.6% downside to Bear $65 / +42.0% upside to Bull $112) | Adj composite 1.57 vs market 2.47: gap -0.90 [OVERVALUED] | +14% above the EPP floor $69 (13x FY14E $5.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: +15.3% total (+7.7%/yr) | At 14.9x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $104 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. comps +1.3% in Q4 FY13, forward sales +3.8% (no FY14 net sales guide in numbers, Q4 FY13 net sales at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
